briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and xAI Colossus escalate AGI race with new multimodal breakthroughs

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI frontier accelerates as multiple labs release frontier models amid rising geopolitical tensions. Funding remains robust while safety concerns mount over unmitigated vulnerabilities in deployed systems.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4 with advanced reasoning; xAI deploys Colossus-2; DeepSeek-V3 closes gap on Western models. Meta releases Llama 4 under open weights sparking industry debate.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New EU AI Act enforcement begins targeting high-risk agents.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp hits 2M units; Google and Microsoft expand TPU and Maia clusters. Saudi Arabia announces $40B AI data center initiative with Oracle.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent systems with protocol-level defenses like DialectForge become the default architecture before the first AGI-level model is publicly released?
